SourceProxy.name: SHYXVmtkCenterlineMerge
SourceProxy.label: SHYX VMTK Centerline Merge

Documentation.short_help: SHYX VMTK Centerline Merge: Optional extract, merge, and/or polyball surface (one output).

SourceProxy.Documentation:
Input: overlapping centerline polylines (LINE / POLY_LINE) with a point-data radius array (default **MaximumInscribedSphereRadius**). No vessel surface. One output port.
Three independent steps. All off: passthrough (shallow copy of the input).
**Extract branches**: vtkvmtkCenterlineBranchExtractor. Output is overlapping tracts with CenterlineIds / TractIds / GroupIds / Blanking. This is the slow pairwise tube test; the result is cached so toggling Merge or Reconstruct does not re-extract unless the input centerlines or radius array change.
**Merge centerlines**: shown only when Extract is on. vtkvmtkMergeCenterlines on the extracted tracts. MergeBlanked (default on) shares bifurcation vertices.
**Split by shared endpoints** (default on): partition input polylines whose endpoints lie within max(radius) of each other, then extract and merge each cluster. Extra Appended paths that tube-overlap several inlet groups no longer glue distant branches. One shared-inlet set stays a single cluster (same as the old path).
**Reconstruct surface**: vtkvmtkPolyBallModeller (polyball line) + isosurface (dist^2 - r^2; IsoValue 0 = tube wall). Reconstruct without Extract/Merge uses the overlapping input (rounder crotch). Reconstruct after Merge models the merged tree (sharper crotch). Reconstruct on: output is the surface; otherwise the current lines.
Requires VMTK compatible with this ParaView VTK (same as SHYX VMTK Opening Centerlines).

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Overlapping centerline polylines. Each cell should be a full source–target path, not a two-point LINE soup. Point data must include a radius array.

StringVectorProperty.name: RadiusArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Radius array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Point-data radius used as the inscribed-sphere tube for branch splitting and for polyball reconstruction. Default **MaximumInscribedSphereRadius** (VMTK Voronoi MISR). Network extraction uses the same name for a local ball estimate, which is a poorer split cue.

IntVectorProperty.name: ExtractCenterlineBranches
IntVectorProperty.label: Extract branches
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkvmtkCenterlineBranchExtractor: split overlapping source–target paths into tracts and write GroupIds / CenterlineIds / TractIds / Blanking. Merge options appear only when this is on. The tract polydata is cached until the input or radius array changes. All steps off: passthrough.

IntVectorProperty.name: MergeCenterlines
IntVectorProperty.label: Merge centerlines
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkvmtkMergeCenterlines: average overlapping tracts in the same GroupId into one polyline per anatomical branch. Shown only when Extract branches is on.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ResamplingStepLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Resampling step length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Absolute point spacing after averaging overlapping tracts. The box is a length. Scale multiplies the current value; Reset fills 1% of the input AABB longest side (BoundsDomain scaled_extent). **0** uses that same 1% on Apply.

IntVectorProperty.name: SplitBySharedEndpoints
IntVectorProperty.label: Split by shared endpoints
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Partition input polylines by endpoints closer than max(radius), then extract and merge each cluster. Keeps extra overlapping paths from joining unrelated inlet groups. Off: one extractor/merger on the whole input (VMTK's single-tree assumption).

IntVectorProperty.name: MergeBlanked
IntVectorProperty.label: Merge blanked (shared bifurcations)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on (default), blanked bifurcation tracts become a shared vertex on upstream and downstream branches so Select Connected sees one tree. Turn off to keep branches disconnected at the n-furcation.

IntVectorProperty.name: ReconstructSurface
IntVectorProperty.label: Reconstruct surface
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Polyball isosurface of the current centerlines (after optional Extract / Merge). Output is this surface instead of lines. Off: output the current lines.

IntVectorProperty.name: SampleDimensions
IntVectorProperty.label: Sample dimensions
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Polyball image size (i j k). Larger is smoother and slower. VMTK’s modeller default is around 64³; raise this if thin branches disappear.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: IsoValue
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Iso value
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Contour of dist² − r². **0** is the tube wall. Positive values inflate; negative shrink.
